_note: Capabilities the marketplace scanner may report for this plugin and that you accept knowingly (installer, privilege, package-manager, service-management, remote-build, sudoers-modification, bundled-executable-binary). Empty means the goal is outcome 'passed' (verified automatically). tests/marketplace-preflight.mjs fails when a new capability appears.

reasons.privilege: scripts/touchpad-access runs pkexec once, at the user's request, to add or remove a udev rule tagging touchpads (ID_INPUT_TOUCHPAD) with uaccess so the tap watcher can read them. Nothing runs privileged otherwise.
